versions.subject: feat: detect PS execution in public folder
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 
        - '-f C:\Users\Public'
        - '-f "C:\Users\Public'
condition: selection

versions.subject: New Rules + Update
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-f C:\Users\Public'
        - '-f "C:\Users\Public'
        - '-f %Public%'
        - '-fi C:\Users\Public'
        - '-fi "C:\Users\Public'
        - '-fi %Public%'
        - '-fil C:\Users\Public'
        - '-fil "C:\Users\Public'
        - '-fil %Public%'
        - '-file C:\Users\Public'
        - '-file "C:\Users\Public'
        - '-file %Public%'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") CommandLine IN ("*-f C:\\Users\\Public*", "*-f \"C:\\Users\\Public*", "*-f %Public%*", "*-fi C:\\Users\\Public*", "*-fi \"C:\\Users\\Public*", "*-fi %Public%*", "*-fil C:\\Users\\Public*", "*-fil \"C:\\Users\\Public*", "*-fil %Public%*", "*-file C:\\Users\\Public*", "*-file \"C:\\Users\\Public*", "*-file %Public%*")
